page_title: AI Video Generator for Text, Image & Reference Videos

summary.name: Vidu
summary.one_liner: Vidu is an AI video generator that creates videos from text prompts, images, and reference images, with a web app and tools for animation and social or ad content.
use_cases: Turning text prompts into short videos
Animating a product or static image
Creating anime or 2D animation with consistent characters
Making social media clips and video ads
Storyboarding and storytelling with reference images
summary.what_it_does: Vidu supports Text to Video, Image to Video, and Reference to Video modes. Image to Video animates a static image and can set first and last frames. Reference to Video takes three or more images of a character, object, or scene and combines them into a video based on a prompt. The My References feature saves characters, props, and scenes for reuse. The page says output ranges from low resolution up to 1080p. It also lists a Creative Tools toolkit and a Vidu Agent that works from a single sentence to a full piece of work, plus enterprise team plans.
notable: Reference to Video with My References for character and scene consistency
Image to Video with first and last frame control
Credit-based usage with free starting credits and Off-Peak Mode mentioned by users
caveats: Paid individual and enterprise plans are referenced, but prices are not listed on the page
Free use is limited to a set amount of credits
Platform list beyond the web app is not stated on the page
